changes.issue: The initial exact-extrema bracket required a strict derivative sign change, so an analytic RC crest already present as an exact-zero derivative sample was missed.
changes.evidence: Four of the original 38 predeclared attempts failed the exported-metric gate G4; their curves retained the correct healthy crest but the chopped descriptor selected the later event voltage.
changes.correction: Include isolated exact-zero derivative extrema and the existing solver's resolved healthy crest before the chopping event; preserve the exact event as a separate corner-extremum candidate.
changes.scope: No equations, scenario cases or thresholds were changed.

changes.issue: Conversion of the event time from microseconds to seconds and back could export the adjacent floating-point time rather than the exact declared timestamp.
changes.evidence: Focused event-grid regression failed strict presence of the declared microsecond event while the physical capacitor-state solution was continuous.
changes.correction: Canonicalize the event grid timestamp to its declared microsecond value. No voltage sample is clipped or multiplied.

changes.issue: Stage-failure negative reversal had been calculated on its first plot grid while the exported waveform used the union of healthy and fault grids.
changes.evidence: Code review found that an additional common-grid sample could yield a lower voltage than the earlier grid and leave reversal metadata inconsistent.
changes.correction: Calculate minimum voltage and reversal from the published common grid for both curves. Explicitly label stage/healthy minima as sampled; chopped continuous extrema are retained.
changes.scope: Published-curve descriptor consistency; no new laboratory-accuracy claim.
